تناهيت (form VI)
# تَنَاهَيْتُ (tanāhaytu) /ta.naː.haj.tu/: first-person singular past active of تَنَاهَى (tanāhā)
# تَنَاهَيْتَ (tanāhayta) /ta.naː.haj.ta/: second-person masculine singular past active of تَنَاهَى (tanāhā)
# تَنَاهَيْتِ (tanāhayti) /ta.naː.haj.ti/: second-person feminine singular past active of تَنَاهَى (tanāhā)
maddeler.t: See the etymology of the corresponding lemma form.
